about: Provenance of every creative file a build can ship, read by web/tools/sourcelicensegate.mjs --inventory. A class describes where a file comes from; it is not a legal approval. review.status is set by a person: NOT_REQUIRED only where the policy below needs no review, REVIEWED only for a review that actually took place (by, date). Evidence is referenced by opaque id; the documents themselves stay private.

policy.noReviewNeeded: original work with an authorship declaration and evidence; third-party work under CC0-1.0, CC-BY-4.0 or OFL-1.1 whose licence text and attribution ship with it
policy.programFiles: scripts, source maps, HTML, JSON, the service worker and licence texts are program or notice files: their source correspondence is checked by tools/verify-release.mjs, not here

macos-system-voices.name: macOS System Voices (the `say` command)

macos-system-voices.evidence: web/src/audio/eva.ts:78 names it "the older macOS `say` british render"; no render script or record exists

review.note: Apple's licence allows System Voices for personal, non-commercial use only, not for publishing. The owner decided on 2026-09-26 to re-render the bank with ElevenLabs; until then web/src/audio/eva.ts leaves it out of every build
